subject.title: feat(signal): add chat-based setup and account linking

question: Should this chat-based Signal setup work be landed as the successor to the overlapping open Signal setup branch, or should the two branches be explicitly consolidated into a smaller reviewed landing sequence?
rationale: Both open branches cover Signal setup and transport ownership, while the earlier branch is dirty and this draft adds shared chat and client behavior; maintainer intent is needed to choose the canonical landing path rather than merge overlapping implementations independently.

options.title: Adopt this PR as the canonical path
options.body: Rebase this branch, prove upgrade behavior and real Signal flows, then close or narrow the older overlapping branch.

options.title: Consolidate into stacked PRs
options.body: Split shared wizard/gateway support from Signal plugin behavior so each compatibility boundary can be reviewed and landed separately.

options.title: Keep the older branch canonical
options.body: Move only clearly missing chat/QR pieces into the earlier branch after resolving its conflicts and proof gaps.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR as the canonical path
recommendation.body: Rebase this branch, prove upgrade behavior and real Signal flows, then close or narrow the older overlapping branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The same contributor owns the active overlapping Signal setup proposals and can clarify the intended successor relationship.
